title: The Flowering Consensus

features.name: the paddock in agreement
features.desc-on-touch: A field blooms in unified height. Every stalk reaches the same point. From altitude this looked like consensus, but standing inside it you sense something different — not agreement imposed but a conversation happening in flowering. Each plant speaks, and the speaking sounds like agreement.

features.name: the pollen drift
features.desc-on-touch: Pollen hangs in visible layers. The archive reads it as data: individual particles in consensus motion, each one small, none of them alone deciding. The air is thick with agreement. You breathe it. It tastes like flowering.

features.name: the singular bloom
features.desc-on-touch: One flower towers above the consensus height by three finger-widths. It blooms a colour the field does not speak. It is alone in its excess. It has not learned to agree, or it has learned agreement only means speaking louder than the rest.

features.name: the consensus archive
features.desc-on-touch: A standing record card lists this paddock's bloom history. Each entry is identical: 'Consensus Achieved'. The handwriting never varies. Then halfway through 2018, one entry is crossed out and rewritten: 'Consensus Being Held'.

inscription: smaller than naming, larger than solitude — the true archive is a congregation of things that cannot speak to the outside world
